# certloom_scope (Data Source)

Looks up a probe scope by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "certloom_scope" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier.
